title: Sandbox
description: Try out commands, hooks and prompts without touching your config
warnCommands: Commands run on your real machine. Use a throwaway directory and avoid destructive commands.

confirmRun.title: Run shell commands on this machine?
confirmRun.desc: The sandbox executes the command you enter directly on your computer with your account's permissions. Only run commands you trust, and prefer a throwaway working directory. You won't be asked again.

hookRunner.title: Hook / command runner
hookRunner.desc: Try a hook or command shell snippet in a one-off run and see its output.

promptScratchpad.title: Prompt scratchpad
promptScratchpad.desc: Draft a system + user prompt and see its size before spending it on a real run.
